outreach_drafts.body:
Attorney-review draft only — not approved to send.

Nicholas, I saw AION Robotics’ public materials describing rugged autonomous vehicles with onboard AI, edge sensing, C3 command/control, and M6/L4 site-management platforms for industrial jobsites. For companies building AI-enabled physical systems, one useful early exercise is pressure-testing whether the invention record clearly captures human technical contribution, ownership, product-roadmap priorities, and the boundary between patent and trade-secret protection.

Jeff Schell has a free AI Patent Strategy Scorecard intended as an educational readiness tool for founders and technical leaders. It is not legal advice, but it may help identify where an AI Patent Strategy Sprint would or would not be worth discussing.

Suggested CTA after approval: invite Nicholas to complete the AI Patent Strategy Scorecard first; if the score indicates high readiness, offer Jeff’s approved Cal.com scheduling link for a short strategy discussion.
